verdict.rationale: Motion's first-party feature pages state that its AI places tasks into time windows on your calendar to hit deadlines, including recurring and voice-created tasks [10, 12, 17]. They also say it reshuffles the whole day or week when meetings run long or emergencies arise [44, 3], and warns about at-risk deadlines [11, 39]. This covers each element of the story, but all of it comes from vendor marketing copy. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-scheduling and re-planning work as claimed, in-depth documentation of how scheduling handles meeting conflicts and deadline trade-offs.
